preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) and all(1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 100000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) and all(1 <= int(line.split()[2]) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each card's power (p_i), magic number (c_i), and level (l_i) are integers within the stated bounds: 1 ≤ p_i ≤ 1000, 1 ≤ c_i ≤ 100000, and 1 ≤ l_i ≤ n.
The number of cards (n) and required total power (k) are integers within the stated bounds: 1 ≤ n ≤ 100, 1 ≤ k ≤ 100000.
The input consists of exactly n + 1 lines: one line for n and k, and n lines for the cards.

postconditions.description: If no valid deck exists, stdout is '-1'. Otherwise, stdout is the minimum level L (1 ≤ L ≤ n) such that there exists a subset of cards with levels ≤ L, total power ≥ k, and no two cards in the subset have magic numbers summing to a prime.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[2]) <= L for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) if stdout.strip() != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If a valid level L is found, all cards in the chosen subset have levels ≤ L. If no valid deck exists, this condition is vacuously true.

postconditions.expression: (lambda: any(sum(p for p, c, l in subset) >= k for subset in subsets if all(c1 + c2 not in primes for i in range(len(subset)) for j in range(i + 1, len(subset)) for c1, _, _ in [subset[i]] for c2, _, _ in [subset[j]])))() if stdout.strip() != '-1' else False
postconditions.description: If a valid level L is found, there exists a subset of cards with levels ≤ L, total power ≥ k, and no two cards in the subset have magic numbers summing to a prime. The `primes` set contains all primes ≤ 200000 (since c_i ≤ 100000, c1 + c2 ≤ 200000).

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == min(L for L in range(1, n + 1) if any(sum(p for p, c, l in subset) >= k for subset in subsets if all(l <= L for p, c, l in subset) and all(c1 + c2 not in primes for i in range(len(subset)) for j in range(i + 1, len(subset)) for c1, _, _ in [subset[i]] for c2, _, _ in [subset[j]]))) if stdout.strip() != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If a valid level L is found, it is the minimum such level. The `subsets` are all possible subsets of cards with levels ≤ L.
